Resolution criteria:
- "Atlanta Braves": Wins if the Atlanta Braves have a higher final score than the Minnesota Twins in their MLB game played on August 19, 2026.
- "Minnesota Twins": Wins if the Minnesota Twins have a higher final score than the Atlanta Braves in their MLB game played on August 19, 2026.

Clarifications:
- The official final score is determined at the conclusion of all innings played, including any extra innings. If the game is postponed and not completed on August 19, 2026 (UTC), resolve based on the completed game's official final score whenever it is played; if the game is cancelled with no result declared, this market is void.
